name: EPIC 220634831

text.card: A red giant 4,618 parsecs away, 15 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 8, give 0.95 solar masses and 14.6 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 4,804 K at its surface.
